title: Collab: concurrent first-creation of an undefined structural container (asClasses) loses one peer's contents (root-key LWW)
description:
SEVERITY: MEDIUM - narrow concurrent-genesis race, but REAL silent collaborative data loss. Found incidentally while verifying task 1359; ORTHOGONAL to 1359 (different mechanism, see below).

== MECHANISM (undefined->defined root-map-key concurrent set => Yjs LWW) ==
createDocument() (packages/core/src/model/document.ts:58-68) initializes `library`, `scenes`, `properties`, `id` but leaves `asClasses` UNDEFINED - the shared container does not exist until first use. The @flash/collab binding represents an absent/undefined field by the ABSENCE of its root Y.Map key (see ymap-fields.ts: 'undefined/absent fields are represented by the ABSENCE of the key'); first use therefore performs a root-map-key set (root.set('asClasses', new Y.Map()) or the binding's equivalent), creating the container.

If TWO peers each FIRST-CREATE that shared container CONCURRENTLY - each sets the same root key to a fresh Y.Map before either creation has synced - Yjs resolves the conflicting ROOT-MAP-KEY writes by LAST-WRITER-WINS at the key level. The losing peer's whole Y.Map (including the class they just added) is DISCARDED; both peers converge to only the winner's container contents. The loser's first-added class is silently lost, with no error surfaced to either user.

== CONCRETE CASE ==
asClasses (the AS2 external-class container). Two collaborators who each add their first .as class at nearly the same time (before sync) => one peer's class vanishes on convergence; the .fla embed then persists only the winner's class.

== RE-CONFIRMED (scratch test, removed; git left clean) ==
Two Y.Docs, async (no live sync). Each first-creates root key 'asClasses' as a fresh Y.Map and adds one distinct class, THEN sync both ways:
  A adds Foo.as, B adds Bar.as (concurrently)
  => after merge BOTH docs converge to asClasses keys = ["Bar.as"] ONLY
  => Foo.as silently discarded (root-key LWW), 100% in this ordering.
This is convergent data loss (both peers agree on the wrong result), not a transient divergence.

== SCOPE ==
Affects ANY undefined->defined STRUCTURAL field - i.e. any container that createDocument (or model defaults) leaves absent and that becomes a shared Y.Map/Y.Array on first use. asClasses is the concrete instance today. Fields that ALWAYS exist on a fresh doc are IMMUNE: `library` is always created by createLibrary(), so its container key exists from genesis and concurrent ADDS into it converge (the keyed-map entries merge; that path is what 1359 covers). The race is specifically at the moment of concurrent container INSTANTIATION on a root key, not at member adds once the container exists.

== ORTHOGONAL TO 1359 ==
Task 1359 (collab shapes intermittently not synced) is the __order Y.Array reconcile corruption (reconcileKeyed delete-all+insert-all in schema.ts) - a DIFFERENT mechanism (positional-array CRDT interleave inside an EXISTING container). THIS bug is a root-MAP-KEY conflict at container genesis (undefined->defined), before/independent of any __order handling. Once the container exists and is shared, subsequent concurrent adds converge correctly - that regime is 1359's domain, not this one. Fixing 1359 does NOT fix this, and vice versa.

== FIX DIRECTION (not applied; code untouched) ==
Eagerly initialize the shared structural containers - asClasses (and any other undefined->defined structural field) - at attach/session-start (when the collab binding attaches, or in createDocument so the field always exists), so the container is created ONCE deterministically and exists before any peer edit. With the key present from genesis there is no concurrent first-creation, and subsequent adds merge as keyed-map entries (the always-present `library` regime).
Alternative / belt-and-braces: a CRDT-safe ensure-container helper that, instead of root.set(key, new Y.Map()), gets-or-creates idempotently in a way that does not blind-overwrite a concurrently-created sibling container (e.g. create the container at attach time inside a single deterministic transaction shared by all peers, or fold any pre-existing container contents in rather than replacing). Initialization at attach/session-start is the simplest robust option.

== ACCEPTANCE (for the fixer) ==
- After fix, two peers that each add their first asClasses class concurrently (async/buffered delivery) converge to the UNION of both classes (no loss). Regression test: bind two peers, deliver async, both add a distinct first class to a doc whose asClasses started undefined; assert both rebuilt docs' asClasses contain both classes.
- Solo and already-present-container cases unchanged (no history churn from eager init on a solo doc).
- Audit other undefined->defined structural fields createDocument omits; ensure each is eagerly present or routed through the ensure-container helper.

References: task 1359 (orthogonal __order reconcile bug); packages/core/src/model/document.ts createDocument; packages/collab/src/ymap-fields.ts (absent-key representation); packages/collab/src/schema.ts.
